items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He asked me to join him at Dante’s on off nights of the Stan Kenton Band.

ctx.x: I guess so. He asked me to join him at Dante’s on off nights of the Stan Kenton Band. We were at the Palladium. I think that’s the period when all of that . . .
Was it Dante’s or the Hague?
